method: With red masked area x and nonred masked area y, 0<=x+y<=M. f=(WR-x)/(W-x-y). Minimum at x=M,y=0; maximum at x=0,y=M. M is an upper bound because native TAN spherical pixel areas are no larger than nominal 0.03arcsec squared and tile overlaps double count.
caveats: Conditional on existing WHT-positive raster areas (about 0.96% area deposition loss).
Does not measure WHT-mask spatial overlap or F444W=26.2 selection completeness or PM detectability.
